traits.name: General's Cry
traits.text: When a hobgoblin general rolls initiative, as long as they can perceive at least one foe, they can yell a mighty battle cry. The hobgoblin general attempts an Intimidate check to Demoralize a single foe within 60 feet as a free action. If successful, any ally with the goblin trait can, as its first action on its first turn of the combat, Stride up to double its speed as a single action.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: composite shortbow (20 arrows), +1 glaive, half plate;

traits.name: Formation
traits.text: When it's adjacent to at least two other allies, the hobgoblin soldier gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.

traits.name: Polearm Critical Specialization
traits.text: On a critical hit, the target of the critical hit is moved 5 feet in a direction of the hobgoblin general's choice.
